claims: Code.org is a non-profit education organization.
Code.org was founded by Hadi Partovi.
Code.org features interactive, block-based, and JavaScript-based coding activities.
Code.org offers self-paced courses, including CS Fundamentals and App Lab.
Code.org features tutorials like "Dance Party," "Minecraft," "AI for Oceans," and "Flappy Code".
Code.org provides CS Fundamentals for grades 3-8.
Code.org provides Game Lab for grades 6-12.
Code.org provides App Lab for app development in JavaScript.
Code.org is a non-profit organization focused on supporting the Hour of Code initiative.
Code is a set of rules used to convert information into another form.
In computing, code is human-readable text (source code) that controls computer behavior.
